# Contributing to VoiceInk-Free

VoiceInk-Free only builds unofficial DMGs of [VoiceInk](https://github.com/Beingpax/VoiceInk).
The app's code comes unchanged from the original project; the root `CONTRIBUTING.md` is the original project's guide.

- **Bugs in the app and feature requests** go to [Beingpax/VoiceInk](https://github.com/Beingpax/VoiceInk/issues).
- **Problems with a VoiceInk-Free DMG, installation or a missing build** — open an [issue here](https://github.com/ergSey/VoiceInk-Free/issues/new/choose).
- **Questions** — [Discussions](https://github.com/ergSey/VoiceInk-Free/discussions).
- **Pull requests** are welcome for VoiceInk-Free's own files only: `scripts/free/`, `.github/`,
  `README.md` / `README.ru.md` and `appcast-free.xml`. Releases are built from the original tags,
  so changes to the app's code here would never reach a release.

By participating you agree to the original project's [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
The code is licensed under [GPL-3.0](../LICENSE).
